propositions: Stale blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural remain durable and unresolved on read, causing epics to block their own children and distorting ready/next-batch scheduling

A store-wide scan must detect three classes of invalid blocking edges: ancestor-blocking (endpoint is ancestor of other), mis-escalated (resolver returns different pair), and unreadable (endpoint cannot be reduced)

Repair must write replacement link before removing stale link to ensure no dependency loss on interruption, and must refuse pairs where the pair-scoped UNLINK would cancel a different relation (ambiguous-pair)
Repair must not hold a store-wide lock across the item loop to avoid deadlocking its own writes, and must write pre-doctor-repair tag at pre-run OID as rollback anchor
Repair must refuse to run while a reconciler pass is in flight and never trigger store reconverge on read-only scan
Residual edges whose source is closed are inert for scheduling and cannot be repaired because add_dependency refuses links from closed sources
